index.interval_scope: response estimation and prescribed ENSO-input uncertainty; not full harvest yield

index_todate.product: CPC weekly Niño-region SST from OISST v2.1, table wksst9120.for, anomalies on the 1991-2020 base; weeks centred on the listed date
index_todate.status: provisional: the month is incomplete and the weekly product is not the one the index tables use
index_todate.note: The weekly value is a conventional Niño 3.4 anomaly from OISST v2.1 (0.25 degree, weekly mean), the monthly index is our ERSSTv5 anomaly (2 degree, monthly) from 01_nino34.py; both are on a 1991-2020 base but from different products and climatologies, so they differ by a few tenths of a degree in the same month (compare previous_month_weekly with monthly_ersst). Neither is the relative index (RONI) of the CPC outlook, which subtracts the tropical mean; the relative September value is monthly_ersst.nino34_rel.

keys.panels: One medium ENSO-outlook row per country, crop and season. The fitted point contrast uses the ENSO-neutral baseline. lo/hi span the central 80% conditional ENSO-effect range; lo_resp/hi_resp vary response coefficients only. Full-harvest residual uncertainty is excluded. Detailed aggregate rows also carry the central 95% range.
keys.world: Production-weighted contrasts on covered reporting support. Ranges are computed after summing shared response fields; no addition of local interval endpoints.
